user.title: Set up Animal Health
user.description: Set up local animal health management.

species.name: Species
species.description: Select a species from the static catalogue. Select Other species for an unlisted species.

custom_species.name: Custom species
custom_species.description: Only required when Other species is selected.

breed.name: Breed
breed.description: Select a breed from the static catalogue or enter a custom value. The species prefix is used only in the selector.

birth_date.name: Birth date
birth_date.description: Optional known or estimated birth date.

arrival_date.name: Arrival date
arrival_date.description: Optional date the animal joined the household or group.

update_animal.name: Update animal
update_animal.description: Updates administrative profile data for an existing animal.

species.name: Species
species.description: New species from the catalogue. Select Other species for an unlisted species.

custom_species.name: Custom species
custom_species.description: Only enter a value when Other species is selected.

breed.name: Breed
breed.description: New breed from the catalogue or a custom value. A catalogued breed must match the catalogued species.

color.name: Color / markings
color.description: New color, pattern or markings. Submit an empty value to clear it.

set_animal_status.name: Change animal status
set_animal_status.description: Changes the animal's factual status without affecting archival visibility.

status.name: Status
status.description: New factual status of the animal.

archive_animal.name: Archive animal
archive_animal.description: Administratively hides the animal without changing its status or history.

restore_animal.name: Restore animal
restore_animal.description: Removes administrative archival without changing the animal status.

create_event.name: Add general logbook event
create_event.description: Adds an immutable free-text observation, diagnosis, treatment, veterinary visit, care or other event.

occurred_at.name: Occurred at
occurred_at.description: Date and time of the event. Current time is used when omitted.

correction_of_event_id.name: Correction of event ID
correction_of_event_id.description: Optional event ID corrected by this new entry. The original event remains unchanged.

record_weight.name: Record weight
record_weight.description: Records a weight measurement with a required value and weight unit.

occurred_at.name: Occurred at
occurred_at.description: Date and time of the event. Current time is used when omitted.

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: Measured weight. A value greater than zero is required.

weight_unit.name: Weight unit
weight_unit.description: Unit used for the weight measurement.

correction_of_event_id.name: Correction of event ID
correction_of_event_id.description: Optional event ID corrected by this new entry. The original event remains unchanged.

record_symptom.name: Record symptom
record_symptom.description: Records a symptom with a structured severity level.

occurred_at.name: Occurred at
occurred_at.description: Date and time of the event. Current time is used when omitted.

symptom.name: Symptom
symptom.description: Select a suggested symptom. Select Other symptom for an unlisted symptom.

custom_symptom.name: Custom symptom
custom_symptom.description: Only required when Other symptom is selected.

correction_of_event_id.name: Correction of event ID
correction_of_event_id.description: Optional event ID corrected by this new entry. The original event remains unchanged.

record_medication.name: Record medication
record_medication.description: Records an administered medication with a required dose and unit. The Swiss product catalogue is for documentation only and does not recommend dosing.

occurred_at.name: Occurred at
occurred_at.description: Date and time of the event. Current time is used when omitted.

medication_name.name: Medication
medication_name.description: Select a product from the static Swiss catalogue or enter another product name. Custom entries are marked as such.

dose.name: Dose
dose.description: Administered numeric dose. A value greater than zero is required.

dose_unit.name: Dose unit
dose_unit.description: Select the unit that was actually administered; no unit is preselected.

correction_of_event_id.name: Correction of event ID
correction_of_event_id.description: Optional event ID corrected by this new entry. The original event remains unchanged.

record_vaccination.name: Record vaccination
record_vaccination.description: Records a vaccination with product, dose and optional batch details. It does not recommend product choice or schedules.

occurred_at.name: Occurred at
occurred_at.description: Date and time of the event. Current time is used when omitted.

vaccine_name.name: Vaccine
vaccine_name.description: Select a vaccine from the static Swiss catalogue or enter another product name.

dose.name: Dose
dose.description: Administered numeric dose. A value greater than zero is required.

dose_unit.name: Dose unit
dose_unit.description: Unit used for the administered dose.

batch_number.name: Batch / lot number
batch_number.description: Optional manufacturer batch or lot number.

correction_of_event_id.name: Correction of event ID
correction_of_event_id.description: Optional event ID corrected by this new entry. The original event remains unchanged.

list_events.name: List logbook events
list_events.description: Returns the newest events for an animal.

limit.name: Maximum events
limit.description: Number of newest events to return.
